description: Enriched cadastral parcel profile by FID or GML ID. Returns municipality, area, cadastral reference, and the requested data sections (risk, subsidence, terrain, buildings, economics, demographics, valuation, valuation_history, solar, POI, etc.). Geometry is omitted to keep the reply compact.

fid.description: Parcel FID number (example "28009975") or GML ID
